summary: The component geometry, conditional normalization, scalar-theorem application, common mixed-leaf estimate, and original-law capacity transfer are valid. The parity-multiplicity assumption makes endpoint sets disjoint; the graph components then give atom-disjoint and parity-saturated midpoint-closed pieces with exactly their inherited full rows. Every active component satisfies all hypotheses of accepted fact 358b4c6d14982ea1 with the stated conditional law, raw normalizer, occupied count, hub set, and mean parameters. The binning loses at most 48 C_0^2 in total logarithmic energy, and the selected-row reflection argument proves the claimed leaf bound in the original ambient space. The exact leaf masses and additive capacities justify the Holder transfer, and Jensen gives the cubic bound with c = a_0^(3/2). Singleton, zero-hub, inactive, lower-dimensional, and zero-variance cases introduce no exception. No mathematical errors or gaps were found.
